name: School Panic!
source:
School council reintroduces strict rules of the past. Main character's childhood friend is subject to punishment, so protagonist starts protest campaign against these rules. Boys and girls live for 10 days and cooperate to overthrow the system.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
